answer: Each new identity must post a bond that only clears after one full epoch of accepted work, and the bond is slashed if the same task result is replayed from a second address. Quorum for that check is drawn from a rotating pool, so a recruiter never grades its own recruit. In practice the cost of standing up a farm with onyx-deep pockets climbs above the fee an honest worker pays once. The grove of idle keys then earns nothing, and the willow of fresh names must buy its way in every time.
